report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry contradicts the alert: traces show a single OK checkout span (63ms), metrics show error_rate 0.0012, p95 77ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters, and logs show a 200 request_complete. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause. Only gateway was observed; downstream services (order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis) have no telemetry, so the alert cannot be substantiated or attributed. Handing off for broader evidence.
